Position Summary
We are seeking a seasoned Backend Engineer to join Asterion Technologies, a mid-stage enterprise focused on real-time financial data infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing and operating high-throughput, low-latency backend services that process market events and customer transactions. You will work closely with product, SRE and data teams to deliver production-grade microservices, improve observability, and scale systems to support rapid business growth. This is a Hybrid role based in Ahmedabad (3 days a week in the office).

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Design
- Lead the design and evolution of backend service architecture to meet performance, reliability and maintainability goals.
- Define service boundaries, APIs and data flow for new capabilities, ensuring compatibility with existing microservices.
- Make technology trade-offs with an emphasis on simplicity, testability and operational excellence.

Development & Implementation
- Build and maintain backend services using Go, implementing clean, idiomatic code and robust error handling.
- Implement high-performance RPC endpoints using gRPC and design efficient payloads and streaming where appropriate.
- Containerize services and manage build/runtime behavior with Docker, including multi-stage builds and image optimization.

Microservices Ownership & Integration
- Own several microservices end-to-end: development, API design, CI/CD pipelines, deployment and incident response.
- Integrate services with downstream systems and third-party vendors, ensuring secure and reliable communication.
- Ensure backward compatibility and smooth rollout strategies for versioned APIs.

Performance, Reliability & Scalability
- Profile, benchmark and tune services for throughput and latency; identify and remediate bottlenecks.
- Implement patterns for resiliency such as retries, circuit breakers, timeouts and graceful degradation.
- Work with SRE to design autoscaling, capacity planning and disaster recovery for critical services.

Observability & Operations
- Instrument services for metrics, traces and structured logs to improve visibility into production behavior.
- Collaborate in defining SLIs/SLOs and alerting thresholds; participate in on-call rotations for rapid incident resolution.
- Create runbooks, post-incident analyses and continuous improvement actions to reduce mean time to recovery.

Mentorship & Collaboration
- Mentor junior engineers, review code, and contribute to engineering best practices and documentation.
- Participate in cross-functional planning, design reviews and prioritization to align engineering output with product goals.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 4-7 years of professional software engineering experience building backend systems in production environments.

Technical Skills (Required/Mandatory)
- Go
- Docker
- gRPC
- Microservices

Other Required Qualifications
- Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, networking and concurrency.
- Proven experience in designing, building and operating RESTful or RPC-based service-oriented architectures.
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing strategies for microservices.
- Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills in distributed systems, including root cause analysis.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to collaborate across engineering and product teams.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-have / Good-to-have)
- Redis
- Prometheus
- Experience with Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
- Familiarity with observability tooling (tracing, metrics backends, log aggregation) beyond Prometheus.
- Experience in financial or real-time event processing domains is a plus.

Success Metrics
- Latency and throughput: Achieve and maintain target p95/p99 latency and throughput goals for owned services as defined by product SLAs.
- Reliability: Reduce production incident count and mean time to recovery (MTTR) for owned services by measurable improvements within first 6 months.
- Deployment velocity: Increase safe, automated deploy frequency and reduce manual rollback incidents through improved CI/CD.
- Code quality and maintainability: Maintain code coverage and reduce technical debt as measured by review feedback, reduced hotfixes and adherence to coding standards.
- Cross-team impact: Deliver at least two high-impact features or infrastructure improvements that enable broader team productivity or customer-facing improvements during the first year.
